rationale: C20 is essentially the same directive issued one year earlier: it concerns the identical carrier and labor organization, repeats the same three factual recitals nearly verbatim, and uses the same reporting deadline and section 10 status-quo provision. The child appears to reuse C20's full drafting template with only the date changed and a minor apparent transcription error ('this employees' for 'its employees'). C05 and C12 are the strongest alternatives because they share the same localized-interstate-commerce formulation and operative machinery, but neither matches the child’s parties as C20 does.
